parsed_output.email_body:
Dear Tatcha Team,

I hope this email finds you well. Our team has been closely following Tatcha's mission and values, and we believe there is a great opportunity to engage younger audiences through a collaborative Instagram post. We propose a behind-the-scenes look at the Tatcha Institute in Tokyo, showcasing the work and philosophy of the institute. This post would not only highlight the institute's mission but also resonate with younger audiences interested in wellness and self-care.

We believe this initiative would help Tatcha reach younger demographics and further solidify its position as a brand that values both science and soul.

Looking forward to your thoughts on this proposal.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
